ranking_basis: P50 delivered cost ascending (per-CFR quantile, not a joint aggregate distribution)

source_concentration.note: Ranked by each CFR's own P50 annual supply (largest first), not by delivered cost -- concentration measures dependence on the biggest few suppliers. Shares are against the sum of each CFR's own P50 (not the joint aggregate P50), consistent with how those per-CFR P50s are ranked and summed here.
